newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: IAWS says placed for further European growth.
newsitem.headline: IAWS says placed for further European growth.

text.p: IAWS Group Plc, the agricultural products group, said on Thursday it was well positioned to develop further in Continental Europe in due course.

The group said in a results statement that the acquisition of a 45 percent shareholding in French fertiliser company Cedest in January was its first move into Continental Europe and had positioned it well to develop further on the continent.
Earlier, IAWS announced a 27 percent rise in pre-tax profits to 6.1 million Irish pounds and a 10 percent gain in turnover to 270 million punts for the six months to January 31, 1997.
"The group earns the greater part of its profits in the second half of the year and trading is satisfactory to date in this period," IAWS said.
IAWS said it had experienced satisfactory trading across all of its activities including new acquisitions.
It said its programme of capital investment had continued during the period and had included the recent extension of the R&H Hall grain terminal at Dublin port.
IAWS said its food business was expanded by the addition of the Master Foods confectionery range in October 1996.
